attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Although framed as mechanical, this sealing of hundreds of Startup/AdminMenu/Permission/Filter classes across virtually every module (plus a non-mechanical refactor moving cookie-auth logic from CacheTicketStoreStartup into a new CookieAuthenticationOptionsConfigure class, and changed hardcoded startup ordering constants like Autoroute's ConfigureOrder) can break any downstream module/theme that currently extends these types for customization, and the sheer scope makes it easy for a subtle behavioral regression to hide among trivial diffs."}
